findings.evidence: TR-2, FR-021, contract Root and namespaces rule 4: SchemaValidator.cs:56-59 CheckUnknownFields returns early for any placeholder-shaped object, and Validate (:100-114) walks only declared fields. Scratch: iskender: { alpha: { secretRef: x, nmae: 1, bogus: 2 } } reported no config.field.unknown or config.namespace.unknown for alpha. T036.

FR-016: the Section branch of SchemaValidator.cs:129-143 continues before the development-only check, and the registry accepts development-only on an object. Scratch: object field debug (development-only) with debug: { level: 5 } under production validated. T037.

Contract Field errors rule 2, FR-018, SC-006: OverlayMerger.cs:27 MergeObjects gives the merged object the higher layer location. Scratch: base iskender: { alpha: {} } with ISKENDER__ALPHA__COUNT=1 gave config.field.required at iskender.persistence.host (ISKENDER__ALPHA__COUNT:0:0, environment) instead of the base document location, and moved it to the end of the order. T038.

FR-020, FR-037, TR-9: ConfigurationValidator.cs:94 passes request.EnvironmentName to ConfigurationLog.LogRejected, written to {Environment} in event 3003 (ConfigurationLog.cs:54) even after config.environment.invalid. Scratch: a name holding the canary, a newline, and 5,000 x gave a 5,094-character 3003 message with the canary and the forged line. T039.

SC-003, US2/AC7, T024: CanaryTests.cs:104-118 uses a fixed environment variable set instead of each fixture sidecar, and never checks the planted run keeps its defect. Scratch: 19 fixtures lost their expected errors when planted (reference_malformed and secret-ref-traversal, too_large/string, raw and escaped control characters, connectionTimeout out-of-range, five-defects, integer-too-large, more-than-100-errors, required and explicit-null hidden by HOST, overlay.conflict, variable-errors-do-not-stop-validation). A direct probe of those paths found no leak. T040.

Contract Secret reference placeholders rule 5, FR-021, T020: OverlayMerger.cs:35-58 WithoutNulls drops a null secretRef member, then SchemaValidator.cs:257-260 reports config.secret.plaintext; EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:146 maps empty or ~ __SECRETREF text to null. Scratch: {"password":{"secretRef":null}} and ISKENDER__PERSISTENCE__PASSWORD__SECRETREF of "" or ~ gave config.secret.plaintext. Found by two auditors, graded Low and Medium; recorded at Medium. T041.

FR-013, FR-019, contract Inputs rules 5 and 9: DocumentBytes.cs:21-28 counts only \n. Scratch: a CR-only JSON document reported config.field.unknown at 1:32 instead of 4:1, and the YAML equivalent at 1:30. T042.

FR-013, FR-019, contract Field errors rules 2 and 4, Environment variables rule 7: OverlayMerger.cs:31 keeps the lowest layer location on a merged placeholder; SchemaValidator.cs:271,278 report at it. Scratch: base key {secretRef: good/name} + overlay key {secretRef: bad/../x} gave reference_malformed at (b:4:7, base); ISKENDER__P__KEY__SECRETREF=/bad gave (b:4:7, base). T043.

FR-016, contract Active environment rule 4: SchemaValidator.cs:173 compares with Uri.Equals, which ignores user info and fragment and folds scheme/host case. Scratch: dev-only uri default https://x.example/ under production accepted https://admin:pw@x.example/, https://x.example/#debug, HTTPS://X.EXAMPLE/ (each a different revision). T044.

Contract Field errors rule 2, FR-018: EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:52 gives a synthesized iskender root the first variable location; SchemaValidator.cs:119 falls back to it. Scratch: no documents + ISKENDER__ALPHA__COUNT=1 gave config.field.required at iskender.persistence.host (ISKENDER__ALPHA__COUNT:0:0, environment), sorted last. Maintainer decision 2026-11-08: not a present ancestor. T045.

SC-003, US2/AC7, TR-9, T024: CanaryTests.cs:83-86,114-129 discard any placement that changes the sidecar errors, so 125 of 255 string slots in negative fixtures never carry the canary (persistence.host never; edge/required-in-unmentioned-object.json 0 of 1); CanaryTests.cs:193-201 checks only three folders and only documents. A full-plant probe found no leak. T046.

FR-016, contract Active environment rule 4: SchemaValidator.cs:148 and HasValue at :425 flag any set member of a dev-only object. Scratch: dbg {verbose: false} (default false), no environment, gave unsafe_for_environment while dbg {} passes with the same canonical form. Maintainer decision 2026-11-08: FR-016 governs over T037 wording. T047.

FR-014, contract Precedence rule 3: OverlayMerger.cs:56-57 keeps every null secretRef member. Scratch: base key {secretRef: good/name} + overlay key {secretRef: null} gave reference_malformed; nested {a: 1, secretRef: null} gave type_mismatch. Maintainer decision 2026-11-08: null absent when merged or in a non-secret object, malformed only standalone. T048. Pass 3: survived. OverlayMerger.cs:79-82 drops a null secretRef beside any other member, so key: {secretRef: null, x: 1} in a secretRef field gave config.secret.plaintext (b:5:10); secretRef: 5 there gives reference_malformed. T054. Pass 4: remediated by T054; key: {secretRef: null, x: 1} in a secret field gives config.secret.reference_malformed.

FR-018: an object field holding a secretRef member reports its present members as missing. Scratch: pool {name: n, secretRef: x} (and secretRef: ~) gave type_mismatch at pool plus a false config.field.required at iskender.persistence.pool.name (b.yaml:3:5). T049.

FR-010, FR-011, contract Inputs rule 3: YamlDocumentReader.cs:36-39 maps the parser treating U+2028/U+2029 as line breaks to config.document.malformed. Scratch: JSON name "x<U+2028>y" accepted; YAML double-quoted gave malformed (b.yaml:1:26), plain at 3:13; single-quoted accepted. T050. Pass 3: survived in a contrived case. YamlDocumentReader.cs:183-201 Separators.For skips every private-use candidate whose hex appears anywhere and then parses unchanged text: a comment listing E000..F8FF plus s: "x<U+2028>y" gave config.document.malformed (b.yaml:4:8); JSON accepts it. T055. Pass 4: remediated by T055.

FR-037, FR-020, contract Diagnostic events, Environment variables rule 7: ConfigurationEnvironmentSource.cs:22-41 accepts any name, unlike ConfigurationDocumentSource.cs:15-18; EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:75,111,119 put it in Location.Source and Path, written to event 3002 (ConfigurationLog.cs:51). Scratch: ISKENDER__ALPHA__CANARY7731\nFORGED + 5,000 x gave a 10,172-character 3002 message with the newline and canary in {Path} and {Source}, and in the rendering. Sibling of CONV-0003-004. T051. Pass 4: remediated by T051; ConfigurationEnvironmentSource rejects ISKENDER__ names over 256 characters or holding control characters.

FR-015, FR-028, contract Environment variables rule 8, Canonical form rule 4: DocumentBytes.cs:90 CheckDecoded and FieldRules.cs:39-47 check only control characters. Scratch: ISKENDER__T__S="a\uD800" validated (document "a\udfff" is malformed at b.json:1:23); canonical form held U+FFFD, so "a\uD800" and "a\uDFFF" gave the same revision cfg-bcrrsarw5pfp6q55... T052. Pass 4: remediated by T052; ISKENDER__PR__S="a\uD800" gives config.document.malformed.

FR-021, contract Field types table (absolute URI, allowed schemes): SchemaValidator.cs:400-406 relies on Uri.TryCreate and uri.Scheme. Scratch: f: c:\x under allowed scheme file validated (written scheme c, stored c:\x); https://x/a b validated. Expected config.field.invalid_format. T053. Pass 4: remediated by T053.

FR-015, contract Environment variables rule 5: EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:142-146 Map returns null on a text error before conflict grouping at :35-44. Scratch: ISKENDER__T__I="\u0001" + ISKENDER__t__i="6" gave only config.document.malformed at iskender.t.i, no config.overlay.conflict. T056. Pass 4: remediated by T056; conflict reported beside the text error.

Contract Field errors rule 2: on a duration field with no maximum, db: 10675200d or 99999999999999999999999ms gave "must be a duration of at least 0ms" (ErrorTextTemplates.cs:67 via SchemaValidator.cs:379-380), which does not name the broken limit. T057. Pass 4: remediated by T057; problem names 922337203685477ms.

Contract Field errors rule 2, FR-018: EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:60-61 gives namespace and object nodes a variable created the variable location. Scratch: no document + ISKENDER__RQ__N=1 (rq.host required) gave config.field.required at ISKENDER__RQ__N:0:0, environment; base {"iskender":{}} + the same gave the same, not b.json:1:13. Maintainer decision 2026-11-09: extend T045 to such nodes. T058. Pass 4: remediated by T058; base {"iskender":{}} plus a variable anchors at b.json:1:13, base.

FR-024, FR-037, contract Text rendering and Diagnostic events: SchemaValidator.CheckUnknown/CheckUnknownFields put an undeclared key raw into the path. Scratch: JSON key "x
config.field.required at iskender.forged (f:1:1, base): forged. Fix: none" under iskender.pr gave a two-line rendering with a forged error line; namespace key "x
FORGED" and YAML key "a	b
FORGED" likewise; a 60,000-character key was echoed whole. The same path reaches event 3002. T059.

Contract Field types number, FR-021: ScalarSyntax.ExactDecimal/Significand reject any exponent above 1,000,000, so 0e9999999 and 0.0e-5000000, exactly 0, gave config.field.out_of_range (b.json:1:71). T060.

FR-019, contract Field errors rule 2, Environment variables rule 8: ErrorTextTemplates.Document is reused for a variable's text, so ISKENDER__PR__S="a\uD800" says 'the document is not well-formed JSON or YAML...' with 'Fix: correct the document where reading stopped.' T061.

FR-011, edge case 'A document that is not valid JSON or YAML', contract Inputs rules 5 and 9: YamlDocumentReader.cs:37 (and Separators.For :207/:215) catches only YamlException; YamlDotNet 18.1.0 throws InvalidOperationException from Scanner.ScanPlainScalar. Scratch: YAML "b: [1, 2\nc: 3\n" made ConfigurationValidator.Validate throw InvalidOperationException instead of returning config.document.malformed; a fuzz run of 200,000 small edits to valid YAML threw 10,215 times from this call site. T062.

FR-024, FR-037, contract Field errors rule 2, Diagnostic events, Environment variables rule 7: ConfigurationEnvironmentSource.cs:22 and ConfigurationDocumentSource.cs:15 reject only char.IsControl, so U+2028/U+2029 pass; EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:76,99,123 put the raw name and segment into the location and path. Scratch: ISKENDER__X<U+2028>Y=1 rendered 'config.namespace.unknown at iskender.X<U+2028>Y (ISKENDER__X<U+2028>Y:0:0, environment)' with the raw separator; a source name holding U+2028 plus a forged error line reached every location, the rendering, and event 3002. Found by two auditors. Same class as CONV-0003-016 and -022, whose fixes covered control characters and document keys only. T063.

Contract Inputs rule 3, TR-3: YamlDocumentReader.cs:89 with IsDefault (:159) rejects only %TAG directives that differ from the default handles. Scratch: '%TAG ! !\n---\niskender: {}' gave only config.field.required errors, no config.document.unsupported_construct; '%TAG !! tag:yaml.org,2002:' likewise. T064.

Contract Inputs rules 5 and 9, FR-013, FR-019: YamlDocumentReader.cs:37-39 reports malformed.Start, which YamlDotNet sets to 1:1 for a tab used as indentation. Scratch: 'iskender:\n\talpha: 1\n' gave config.document.malformed at t.yaml:1:1, not 2:1; an unclosed quote reports the opening quote rather than where reading stopped. T065.

FR-008 schema faults table, FR-028, contract Canonical form rule 4: ConfigurationSchemaRegistry.cs:277-279 DefaultSatisfies checks control characters and length but not lone surrogates, and CheckConstraints (:241-252) does not check enumeration member text. Scratch: text defaults 'a\uD800' and 'a\uDFFF' both registered and gave the same revision (cfg-2bptzzlv...) while GetString returned different text; enumeration member and default 'a\u0001' registered. T066.

Contract Canonical form rule 4 ('A string is its exact code points'), TR-8, FR-028: CanonicalWriter.cs:18-23,72 uses JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping, which escapes emoji, U+2028, U+E000 and unassigned U+0378 while writing U+00AD and U+FFFD raw. Which code points are unassigned depends on the runtime's Unicode tables, so revisions could differ across hosts (inferred from the encoder, not observed across runtimes). T067.

FR-013, SC-006, contract Field errors rule 2: SchemaValidator.cs:152-154 reports config.value.unsafe_for_environment for a development-only object at the merged object, which keeps the lowest layer's location (OverlayMerger.cs:31-36). Scratch: base {"iskender":{"diag":{"debug":{}}}} plus ISKENDER__DIAG__DEBUG__VERBOSE=true, or an overlay setting verbose: true, reported iskender.diag.debug (b.json:1:30, base). T068.

SC-006, FR-036: only invalid/unknown-field-near-miss.json has its fix asserted (ValidationTests.cs:27-29); invalid/config.field.unknown/unknown-field.json (hots) and beside-secret-ref.json (nmae) are checked for code, path and location only. Behavior is correct (probe: 'did you mean host?', 'did you mean name?'). T069.

Contract Snapshot rule 2, FR-029, Precedence rule 3: EnvironmentVariableReader.cs:48 skips only a null scalar; a __SECRETREF variable of "", ~ or null maps to a null placeholder (:157-161), counted at :70, which OverlayMerger.cs:47-50 drops as absent. Scratch: base key {secretRef: good/name} + ISKENDER__PR__KEY__SECRETREF="" gave EnvironmentVariableCount 1 and event 3001 "environment variables 1"; base s: v + ISKENDER__PR__S__SECRETREF="" gave the same revision as no variables. Maintainer decision 2026-11-09: fix. T070.

Contract Field types number, FR-021: ScalarSyntax.cs:220-224 Significand returns null for |exponent| > 1,000,000, so ExactDecimal rejects a non-zero value regardless of digits. Scratch: 1 followed by 1,000,001 zeros e-1000001 (about 1,000,050 bytes) gave config.field.out_of_range at b.json:1:23; 1<2000 zeros>e-2000 is accepted. Same family as CONV-0003-023.

acceptance.rationale: No practical impact: it needs a document of about 1 MB holding one number, and the exponent bound guards against costly parsing. Accepted by the maintainer on 2026-11-09.

findings.evidence: FR-024, contract Text rendering, Field errors rule 2: ErrorTextTemplates.cs:95,193 join enumeration members raw and uncapped; the registry allows tab, LF and CR in members. Scratch: a member holding \n plus a forged error line split one error into 3 rendered lines; 2,000 members gave a 45,877-character line. Event 3002 unaffected, no value leaked.

acceptance.rationale: Enumeration members are trusted schema text written by the section author in code, not operator input, and no value leaks. Accepted by the maintainer on 2026-11-09.
acceptance.evidence: Pass 6 errors-rendering audit probes P1 and Q5; ErrorTextTemplates.cs:95,193.

findings.evidence: quickstart.md:29-30 names Fixtures/invalid/five-defects.yaml and unknown-field-near-miss.yaml; only the .json fixtures exist (ValidationTests.cs:30,110). Maintainer decision 2026-11-09: fix. T071.
